preferences.title: Display settings
preferences.description: Choose your language, how dates and times are shown, how large and heavy text is, and the font. These apply to your account only; language and date/time also apply to the shop-floor tablets (text size, bold text and font are web only).
preferences.languageHelp: The language of the interface. Screens that are not translated yet stay in Japanese.
preferences.timeZoneHelp: Which region's clock dates and times are shown in. The stored timestamps themselves do not change.
preferences.textSizeHelp: How large text and spacing are across the app. Your choice is applied right away and kept when you save.
preferences.boldTextHelp: Makes body text one step heavier. Headings and emphasis, already bold, stay as they are.
preferences.fontFamilyHelp: The screen font. PDF documents keep their own font, unaffected by this.
preferences.previewTextSample: Check the order acknowledgement lines and confirm it if the prices match.
